messages:
incident-bot: [P0] KV-cache growth + continuous-batching perf cliff detected in us-east-1. Symptoms: tail latency spike, sustained CPU/GPU mem pressure on serving pods, and an uptick in 500s from model-reroute. Paging oncall.
ryan: I got the page, looking now. Initial hypothesis: a recent continuous-batching tune + speculative decoding enabled caused KV cache churn and replay growth.
sara: Seeing increased write amplification to kvcache in prom dashboard (kvcache.items_created spike). Links: https://grafana/redwood/d/QoP/kvcache?orgId=1
maria: Customer impact report: 3 customers showing elevated latencies; top affected: beta-analytics (regen endpoint), acme-search (ranker). Error rate ~4.6% 5xx over last 10m.
raj: Logs show repeated cache misses followed by huge entries being written during speculative decode fallback paths. Example stack:
```
2024-04-06T02:12:03Z model-server[pid=89]: speculative_decode: fallback->target mismatch, replay_length=10240, kvcache_put size=9.8MB
2024-04-06T02:12:03Z model-server[pid=89]: batch_dispatch: continuous-batch window=25ms, batch_size=48
```
ryan: I'm going to lower continuous-batch window and disable speculative decoding on the hot fleet as a quick mitigation.
tim: +1 to disabling speculative decoding, that's been the main correlating factor in sandbox too.
raj: Proposed quick actions:
- set speculative_decoding.enabled = false for model-family redwood-v2-* in us-east-1
- reduce continuous_batch.window_ms from 25 -> 5 for hot pods
- run a kvcache eviction sweep for entries > 1MB
- temporarily rate-limit heavy regen endpoints for affected customers
maria: Support: notifying top affected customers (beta-analytics, acme-search). Draft message ready to send once we know ETA.
ryan: Executing rollout via console: changing rollout policy to canary 5% -> apply to hot nodes.
```
# hitting admin API
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/ops/flags -d '{"speculative_decoding.enabled": false, "scope":"us-east-1","models":"redwood-v2-*"}'
# response OK
```
sara: I'm patching the batch config now.
```
kubectl -n serving patch config continuous-batcher --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/window_ms","value":5}]'
```
raj: Running kvcache sweep (manual) on the hot pool:
```
redwoodctl kvcache evict --region us-east-1 --model redwood-v2-13b --size-gt 1048576
# evicted 128 entries, reclaimed 1.2GB
```
tim: After those changes, Prom: 95th latency dropped from 4.2s -> 1.1s within 4 minutes. Error rate trending down to 0.9%.
maria: Support message sent to beta-analytics with workaround and apology. acme-search notified as well. Both asked for status; updated them that we applied mitigations and are monitoring.
support-bot: Created incident ticket RT-20240406-773 and attached recent logs.
ryan: Root cause theory: speculative decoding creates transient draft traces that can differ widely from target tokenization/length; the continuous-batcher groups drafts and targets into same kvcache keys causing oversized entries and eviction pressure -> cascade of misses and replays -> perf cliff.
sara: Agreed. Next steps for medium-term patch:
- change kvcache keying to include speculative flag (draft/target) to avoid collisions
- add caps per-entry size and reject writes > 2MB with fallback to direct compute
- introduce adaptive batch window that shrinks under high kvcache write rate
raj: I'll draft the kvcache keying PR and add tests.

Action items (short):
- Ryan: monitor for 30m, escalate if error rate > 2%
- Sara: follow up with infra to make speculative decoding opt-in per-fleet
- Raj: PR for keying + size cap (target: deploy to staging in 24h)
- Maria: customer comms and post-incident summary

ryan: Handoff in 30m to sara (I'm hitting another pager). If things reflare, re-enable heavy throttles and roll back to previous configs.
sara: Taking over monitoring at 03:00 UTC. Will keep this channel updated. Thanks team.

(30m later)

sara: Quick update: system stable for 20m, kvcache write rate normalized, continuous-batch window at 5ms handling load. Error rate steady ~0.6%.
maria: Customers acknowledged the update, beta-analytics requested a follow-up postmortem.
raj: Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kvcache/pull/418 - adds speculative bit to key and size cap enforcement. Link has tests + perf bench.
r band: (accidental typo) — ignore
sara: Reassigning incident to postmortems channel after we finish notes. Leaving this channel for any hot reopens.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: P0 -> mitigated. Duration: ~42m. Severity: P0 -> downgraded. See RT-20240406-773 for logs and next steps."
